posts.trend: In appeal to Centre, Maharashtra petrol dealers seek UPI MDR exemption
posts.context: Parents view digital transactions with structural, ancestral suspicion that is slowly starting to look justified.
posts.angle: The older generation's paranoia about digital money is beginning to look like sound financial planning.
